stem: Meena is helping her science teacher sort substances found at home in Delhi. Which statement about elements is not correct?

options.text: A pure substance made of only one kind of particle is an element.
The oxygen gas in a cylinder is an element, even though its atoms are joined in pairs as molecules.
When atoms join together to form a molecule, the substance must be a compound.
A copper wire contains only copper particles, so copper is an element.

teacher.key_rationale: A molecule formed from identical atoms (e.g., O2) is still an element because the substance contains only one kind of particle; claiming that molecule formation implies a compound is the incorrect statement, so C is the answer.
